name: Lower Austria
summary: Two horizontal bands of blue over yellow. The colours come from the state arms: five golden eagles on blue, attributed in the Middle Ages to Saint Leopold.
origin: The five eagles were invented as arms for Saint Leopold III, the Babenberg margrave, in the 14th century. Lower Austria became a separate state from Vienna in 1920–1922.

colors.name: Blue
colors.meaning: The field of the five-eagle arms.

facts: Its capital is St. Pölten, chosen in 1986.
clues: Blue over yellow, two horizontal bands.
Its colours come from five golden eagles attributed to a saint.
The Austrian state that surrounds the capital.
